code: OpenMolcas v26.06 (DKH2 + AMFI, RASSCF/RASSI-SO) and Kuiva
confound: NOT a controlled single-variable comparison. OpenMolcas differs from Kuiva in the Hamiltonian (DKH2 vs X2C), in the two-electron spin-orbit treatment (Breit-Pauli AMFI, which has no two-electron scalar picture change at all, vs X2CAMF) and in how the splitting is obtained (RASSI-SO term energy vs one-particle spinor splitting). The third is reduced to the choice of orbitals by taking a p^5 cation, whose (5e,3o) active space spans exactly the three components of 2P and holds no correlation; the first two remain and this table cannot separate them.
observable: the ²P₃/₂-²P₁/₂ splitting of a singly charged p-block cation: one hole outside a closed shell, and therefore the one open-shell case where a term splitting and a one-particle splitting are the same observable
purpose: method-decomposition table for the two-electron spin-orbit treatment

Ar.construction: self-consistent two-component average-of-configuration SCF in the contracted molecular basis; the mean field is decoupled in the primitive basis and contracted back
